switchWorkdir.title: Switch working directory to this folder
analyzeProject.title: Analyze this project
config.gatewayUrl.description: WebSocket URL of the OpenClaw gateway
config.supervisor.intervalMinutes.descri: How often (minutes) to check the current agent output. Set to 0 to disable supervision.
config.supervisor.stopSignalContent.desc: Stop signal content — pipe-separated list (e.g. done|finished|completed). When the agent output contains any of these, supervision stops.
config.supervisor.reminderMessage.descri: Reminder message sent to the current agent when its output is unchanged (empty = no reminder).
config.supervisor.agentId.description: Supervisor agent ID to perform periodic checks (e.g. manager, main).
config.supervisor.stopInquiryMethod.desc: Prompt method prefix for supervisor inquiry (e.g. 请判断, Judge, Evaluate).
config.supervisor.stopSignalReply.descri: Reply text from the supervisor agent that triggers stop (case-insensitive match).
